```yaml
name: Cleanup Preview Branch

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  cleanup-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Configure Neon CLI
        env:
          NEON_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEON_API_KEY }}
          DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED }}
          NEON_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.NEON_PROJECT_ID }}
        run: |
          echo "export NEON_API_KEY=$NEON_API_KEY" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "export DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=$DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "export NEON_PROJECT_ID=$NEON_PROJECT_ID" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Get PR number
        id: pr_number
        run: echo "::set-output name=pr_number::${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"

      - name: Delete Neon branch
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ steps.pr_number.outputs.pr_number }}
          BRANCH_NAME="preview-$PR_NUMBER"
          curl -X DELETE "https://api.neon.tech/v1/projects/${{ vars.NEON_PROJECT_ID }}/branches/$BRANCH_NAME" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEON_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/cleanup-preview.yml` sets up the cleanup process for preview database branches when a pull request is closed. It checks out the code, sets up Node.js, installs dependencies, configures the Neon CLI with necessary environment variables, retrieves the PR number, and then deletes the corresponding Neon branch using the Neon API.

      - name: Configure Neon CLI

      - name: Get PR number
        id: pr_number
        run: echo "::set-output name=pr_number::${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"

      - name: Delete Neon branch

          PR_NUMBER=${{ steps.pr_number.outputs.pr_number }}
